identity: Blade of the House of Spiders Ryōshū
frame_indexing: Zero-based source decoded frame. End frames exclusive. Source PTS = frame * 1001 / 30000.
accuracy: Contacts denote first visible intersection/impact, not hidden engine damage ticks. Native neighborhoods resolve listed events to source frames; other envelope transitions sampled every two source frames have up to one-frame uncertainty. Coin mappings are hypotheses without HUD.
scale: H = standing caster body height in the SAME shot. Distances are screen-plane estimates; not inferred from effect length.
color_note: Hex colors are visual palette approximations, not calibrated pixel measurements.
sheet_note: overview sheets are 6 fps; detail sheets select even source frames (~14.985 fps). detail f-label is SAMPLE index, not source frame; use timestamp. Native sheets label actual SRC frame; windows may be discontinuous.
name: Rend Space - String Connection (tentative)

evidence: Gold aura, prolonged kneeling then overhead stance, and two separated horizontal cut releases at 1613 and 1762.
Two primary releases match two coins; Shin association with gold aura is inference, not a visible label.
alternatives: Gold aura may be pre-existing passive state, not unique to String Connection.

weapon.type: Long narrow curved single-edged sword; katana/nodachi-like silhouette, with separate dark scabbard
weapon.held: One hand controls hilt in visible dash poses; other hand manages scabbard. Exact fingers/grip obscured in motion. Two separated hands support sword/scabbard assembly above head in overhead poses.

parts_colors.hilt: dark violet #26233D with pale diagonal wrapping #A7A3BC
parts_colors.cord: thin dark cord at hilt/scabbard; red ribbons/threads accompany body

weapon.measurement_note: Screen-space estimates from chibi sprite; camera scaling and foreshortening preclude exact world dimensions.

props.path: outward drift from center; radial streaks toward screen edges

caster_motion.description: Lower into kneel; <0.5 H displacement, hold sword/scabbard near ground.
Rapid masked first pass; source camera prevents exact trajectory; settle back at right.
Sweep crescent in place and rise with sword/scabbard overhead.
Hold overhead, briefly spread arms and lower stance around 56.256; return overhead by 56.990.
Second release from stationary pose; camera backs away; <0.5 H motion.

hits.note: Camera cut masks approach; caster ends right again. Do not classify the whole sequence as stationary melee.

hits.note: Beam is visual geometry, not a claim of a gun/laser weapon. Caster remains right with weapon overhead.

beats.description: Kneeling wind-up inside already-present gold flame-shaped aura.
Blue knot ring at hilt, horizontal glint, increasing white-blue orbital ribbons.

Overhead hold; separated arms pose at 56.256–56.857, then long glint hold.
Blue knot ring grows around face/hilt.
Second release: dark blue full-screen wash, horizontal band, angular broken-glass lattice.
Lattice fades to shards; gold caster remains right; scene edit ends recovery.

effects.fade: persists across skill; no inferred damage

repeats.confidence: high visual match of two releases; med kit mapping

Second cyan release from overhead pose

repeats.differences: Burning hall; first wind-up starts with scabbard close-up. At 2424 overhead reset; 2450–2452 three-frame face/weapon cut-in; white editorial transition at 2508 ends gameplay. Gold caster appears stationary during both releases in this version.

coin_comparison.note: Visual contact groups do not establish hidden game damage events. Null coins retain unresolved mapping.
